releases.notes:
# Release notes for version 0.99.0

**Release date:** 23 Nov 2026

![Helm: v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/Helm-v3.14%2B-informational?color=informational&logo=helm&link=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhelm%2Fhelm%2Freleases%2Ftag%2Fv3.14.0) ![AppVersion: v1.157.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/v1.157.0-success?logo=VictoriaMetrics&labelColor=gray&link=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.victoriametrics.com%2Fvictoriametrics%2Fchangelog%2F%23v11570) ![VM Operator: 0.68.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/VM_Operator-0.68.2-success?logo=kubernetes&logoColor=7B3FE4&labelColor=white&link=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.victoriametrics.com%2Fhelm%2Fvictoria-metrics-operator%2Fchangelog%2F%230682)

**Update note 1**: if `prometheus-node-exporter.containerSecurityContext` sets `privileged: true` or adds `SYS_ADMIN` capability (e.g. for the `perf` collector), also set `allowPrivilegeEscalation: true` there, otherwise the API server rejects the node exporter DaemonSet. Set the new security context keys to `null` to restore the previous behaviour.

- bump version of VM components to [v1.157.0](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.157.0)
- bump version of VL components to [v1.54.0](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/releases/tag/v1.54.0)
- bump kube-state-metrics dependency chart to version 9.0.1. Its pod now has `nodeSelector: kubernetes.io/os: linux` by default; set `kube-state-metrics.nodeSelector: null` to remove it.
- bump prometheus-node-exporter dependency chart to version 5.1.0. Node exporter and kube-rbac-proxy containers now run with `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, all capabilities dropped and `seccompProfile.type: RuntimeDefault`; liveness and readiness probe timeouts are raised from 1s to 5s.
- bump grafana dependency chart to version 14.4.1 (Grafana 13.3.0). The chart now validates `grafana` values against a schema, so wrongly typed values (e.g. a numeric `image.tag` or label value, a quoted `service.port`) fail the install or upgrade. Grafana pods no longer have the `helm.sh/chart` label.
- bump version of alertmanager to [v0.35.0](https://github.com/prometheus/alertmanager/releases/tag/v0.35.0)
- add `vmalert.notifierConfig` with settings added to every generated alertmanager notifier, e.g. `tlsConfig` for a TLS-enabled alertmanager. See [#3352](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/helm-charts/issues/3352).

releases.name: victoria-logs-agent-0.2.11
releases.notes:
# Release notes for version 0.2.11

**Release date:** 13 Nov 2026

![Helm: v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/Helm-v3.14%2B-informational?color=informational&logo=helm&link=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhelm%2Fhelm%2Freleases%2Ftag%2Fv3.14.0) ![AppVersion: v1.54.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/v1.54.0-success?logo=VictoriaMetrics&labelColor=gray&link=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.victoriametrics.com%2Fvictorialogs%2Fchangelog%2F%23v1540)

- bump vlagent version to [v1.54.0](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/releases/tag/v1.54.0).
- add `serviceAccount` options. A dedicated ServiceAccount is created by default and the API token isn't mounted (`serviceAccount.automountToken: false`), as vlagent doesn't access the Kubernetes API. Pods are restarted once on upgrade.
- add `service.portOverrides`, a map keyed by Service port name to override `port`, `protocol`, `targetPort`, `nodePort` and/or `appProtocol`. It applies to every rendered Service port, including `http[]`, `extraPorts[]` and `syslog-tcp`/`syslog-udp`. See [#3223](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/helm-charts/issues/3223).
- add `podManagementPolicy` option for the StatefulSet. Set it to `Parallel` to match the StatefulSet created by the VictoriaMetrics operator, so that it can be adopted in place when migrating from a VLAgent custom resource.

# Release notes for version 0.98.0

**Release date:** 09 Nov 2026

![Helm: v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/Helm-v3.14%2B-informational?color=informational&logo=helm&link=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fhelm%2Fhelm%2Freleases%2Ftag%2Fv3.14.0) ![AppVersion: v1.156.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/v1.156.0-success?logo=VictoriaMetrics&labelColor=gray&link=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.victoriametrics.com%2Fvictoriametrics%2Fchangelog%2F%23v11560) ![VM Operator: 0.68.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/VM_Operator-0.68.2-success?logo=kubernetes&logoColor=7B3FE4&labelColor=white&link=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.victoriametrics.com%2Fhelm%2Fvictoria-metrics-operator%2Fchangelog%2F%230682)

- bump version of VM components to [v1.156.0](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.156.0)
- bump version of VT components to [v0.13.0](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaTraces/releases/tag/v0.13.0)
- sync-job: add `defaultDashboards.dashboards.<name>.variables.<variable>` with `query` to replace a dashboard variable query or add a missing variable, and `regex` to replace the variable regex (empty string removes it). The cluster picker is now the variable whose `label_values()` query lists the cluster label, instead of any variable named `cluster`, so the etcd and VictoriaLogs cluster dashboards, which use a `cluster` variable for job names, keep it and get a separate `k8s_cluster` picker. `defaultDashboards.dashboards.<name>.clusterMetric` is deprecated in favor of `variables.<variable>.query: label_values(<metric>, cluster)` and ignored when `variables` is set for the same dashboard; defaults are migrated. See [#3331](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/helm-charts/issues/3331).
